name: Maintenance Grant for Children with Disabilities from Birth
benefit: ₹700/- per month is provided to parents or guardians for caring for their children.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be the parent or guardian of a child with more than 40% disability. - The child must be below 18 years of age. - The family’s monthly income must be less than ₹4,000/- or the family must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
